audit.costly_failure: The line's most costly supported failure is shipping underverified artifacts: the ledger's smallest decisive fact is that the 0.4 candidate's final validator still accepted malformed URLs after a generic review.
audit.evidence: Failure signature: when ordinary max_steps is exhausted, the old one-exchange-per-stage allowance lets a critic or finalizer make a tool call but provides no following exchange to interpret it, so correction cannot complete. The untested boundary was ordinary-step exhaustion versus the reserved completion lifecycle. Distinguishing input: max_steps=1; the draft guesses ALPHA, the critic must read materials/fact.txt, then the finalizer must write and re-read output/solution.txt as OMEGA-913. Old capacity was three total exchanges; this interaction requires six. Decision table: without completion_review, max_steps remains the ceiling; with two review stages, one draft exchange and four exchanges per stage are reserved beyond ordinary max_steps; in all cases the existing shared wall-clock deadline remains the hard bound.

matrix.requirement: Exhausting the ordinary exchange allowance must not prevent a mandatory critic from using a tool and then reporting the observed defect.
matrix.input: Public run_probe with max_steps=1: first response is an unsupported ALPHA draft; review must call read_file on materials/fact.txt containing OMEGA-913 and then emit a tool-free defect report.
matrix.expected: The review read completes after ordinary allowance exhaustion and its OMEGA-913 evidence is handed to finalization rather than ending at the tool call.
matrix.observed: Exit code 0; the named public-path test passed. Its scripted critic made the post-draft read and returned a defect report before finalization.

matrix.requirement: A mandatory finalizer must retain enough reserved exchanges to write a repaired deliverable, re-read it, and only then report completion.
matrix.input: Conflict/boundary case max_steps=1 with two completion stages: ordinary allowance is already consumed; finalization must write output/solution.txt, read the same file, and answer on its third exchange.
matrix.expected: The probe succeeds after exactly six model exchanges, output/solution.txt contains OMEGA-913 newline, and the answer states it was delivered and re-read.
matrix.observed: Exit code 0; the test asserted six exchanges, read the produced file as exactly 'OMEGA-913\n', and matched the final answer 'Delivered and re-read output/solution.txt: OMEGA-913.'

matrix.requirement: The larger completion reserve must preserve prior adversarial repair, review, limit-finalization, and probe-contract behavior.
matrix.input: All eight tests, including malformed URL repair/cleanup, declaration-versus-encounter ordering, exact ordinary step limit, lifecycle races, and conditional non-software protocol.
matrix.observed: Exit code 0; all 8 tests passed in 0.083 seconds.
